title: Calaboose African American History Museum

blurb: Located in Hays County’s first jail constructed in 1873, the Calaboose African American History Museum (CAAHM) was organized in 1997 by Mrs. Johnnie Armstead. Actor and director, Robert Redford’s great-grandfather, Zachariah P. Bugg, a former Confederate soldier, was the sheriff of Hays County when the Calaboose was built.
